summary: Feed s077_single to IDS is degraded due to 17.8% duplicate packets (736/4124). All other visibility checks (one-way, VLANs, encryption, truncation, tunnels, drops, overload, oversize) are healthy, but duplicates waste IDS resources and reduce detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Same packets are arriving via multiple SPAN/mirror or TAP paths aggregated through the packet broker without deduplication. The broker is forwarding both copies of packets seen at different switch hops to the single IDS tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with full-payload inspection wastes CPU/memory re-processing identical packets, inflates flow and alert counts, and risks missing true threats due to resource contention and state-table bloat.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication (hash-based, ~10ms window) on the feed to s077_single so only one copy of each packet is delivered to the IDS, restoring accurate traffic representation without overloading the tool.
